Message:
Since I had nowhere else to go,
Gracie let me live
with her in her mansion.

Um, let’s see...
I think she told me
I would be her “living surf-ant...”

But, she didn’t stop at just
sharing her mansion and food—
she even gave me an allowance!

“Here you go.
This is your payment
for the month.”

“What are you going on about?
It’s only fair to receive
compensation for your work.”

but Gracie really is
too good to me.

I mean, not only
did she save me,
but she’s done so much
for me since!

Hehehe! That’s why...
I’ve gotta repay her by
helping out as much as I can!

Every morning starts with
taking care of Gracie’s pet, Anne!
I take her for walkies,
then give her brushies!

Then, Gracie and I get to
making breakfast together, but...

On the table sat plates with
burnt blocks of toast and a runny,
scrambled mess of eggs.

“Hah... It looks like
I’m out of practice myself.”

“...At the very least,
I can commend you
on your optimism.”

Oookie-dokie!
Next time I’ll be sure
not to burn anything
and make Gracie happy!♪
